name: codex-orchestration
description: Orchestrate visible Codex tasks with explicit model routing, bounded ownership, and quiet durable results.

interface.longDescription: Use one coordinator to plan and govern multiple user-visible Codex tasks with explicit model routing, bounded ownership, reconciled host operations, quiet durable results, serial integration, audited closure, and a clean per-repository unplug path.
defaultPrompt: Plan this work across separate Terra executor tasks.
Run this workflow with one Sol coordinator and Terra tasks.
Review and integrate the journaled task results.
Unplug Codex Flow cleanly from this repository.
